verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents API access tokens that can be scoped to restrict which operations they perform, explicitly so you can 'build an integration', which shows a public, programmatically drivable API. However, the pack has no API reference page or endpoint coverage, and probes for a machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec at standard paths all returned 404. The CLI and MCP server are separate surfaces and are not credited here. missing for 10: cited API reference documentation showing endpoint coverage for managing flags and other resources, a discoverable OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product through the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: You can scope your API tokens to restrict the set of operations they can perform. For example, you can build an integration that only has read access
